name: Gated-Amalgam Closure Reduces to Prime Obstructions
statement: The cover-recursively peripheral class is closed under gated amalgamation if and only if every one of its forbidden pc-minors is gated-prime. Every antipodally punctured cube $Q_n^{--}$ is gated-prime. Exact coordinate-face audits also make the pentagonal obstruction $\mathcal P_5$ and Hall-derived obstruction $\mathcal H_{22}$ gated-prime.
proof: A proper gated decomposition of a minimal obstruction has both pieces as proper convex pc-minors in the class, contradicting closure. Conversely, track the two gated pieces through a descent to a minimal forbidden pc-minor: nonempty restrictions and contractions preserve gatedness, intersection, properness, and membership of both images, producing a forbidden gated decomposition. For $Q_n^{--}$, two proper Boolean faces cannot cover all but two cube vertices; the finite claims follow from exhaustive gated coordinate-face audits.
